notes.title: 11/12 Update for Band Camp Boyfriend
notes.notes:
It's hard to believe Band Camp Boyfriend has been out for half a year! Today, I've updated the game with these fixes...

-Added a missing bad ending to the ending list.
-Fixed a bug where Poptart's fourth CG was only unlocking through playing the bad ending.
-Added a couple voice lines for Tom and Peter that got lost in the mix during production.
-Fixed some new issues that were popping up with the font.
-Changed Flora's name to "Lite" in the opening/credits.
-Fixed a couple other minor typos/errors.

Fingers crossed everything is in order. 

Remember, if the game crashes for any reason, please try verifying the integrity of the files to see if that fixes it! We've had a couple reports of the game crashing on a random CG, but it turns out it was Steam-related and thankfully an easy fix. Here's how to do so: https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/0C48-FCBD-DA71-93EB

As always, thanks so much for playing Band Camp Boyfriend! Hope you all have an enjoyable holiday season. Don't forget to follow Lovebird Game Studios on social media for future updates--we hope to release some BCB-related goodies in the future! :)

-Taylor

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Band Camp Boyfriend will release in its entirety on May 11, 2023.

I expect to see every single one of you on that field, fully hydrated and ready to work hard! We’ve got a show to learn!
